name: Great Junction Drydock
description: Where the Saraswati Canal meets the Tethys estuary. On D-Day the water drained into geothermal fissures here, and the Kelpfang-II set out from this pier.
notes: From the Age of Machinery chart, where it sits in 'Saraswati Delta'. Its position is that era's, before the Shattering; canon states no other.
